blocks.text: The formal reasoning plan outlines a proposed forward derivation in which Raychaudhuri-type focusing is applied under AANEC and an explicit averaged null-convergence condition to suggest trapped-surface formation when compactness exceeds a model-dependent threshold. This derivation remains unverified, and the final exclusion of stable non-black-hole remnants is treated as a candidate formal proposition rather than a proved result.

A counterexample search plan is proposed to test whether hypothetical regular metrics or stable exotic compact objects can evade the compactness bound while satisfying all stated assumptions. Because the mathematical form of the averaged focusing condition and the definition of the Misner-Sharp compactness parameter are missing, the validity of any candidate counterexample cannot currently be determined.

The verification plan for the formal theorem and the counterexample boundary analysis requires human input. Specifically, the explicit mathematical form of the averaged null-convergence condition and the formal definition of the Misner-Sharp compactness parameter are unresolved, preventing rigorous proof or disproof of the proposed exclusion bound.
